notes: r=16/alpha=16 on all attention+MLP projections: the standard Unsloth starting point.
epochs 3 on ~1k examples is the usual sweet spot; more epochs on a small corpus buys repetition of house tics, not capability.
max_seq_length 2048 matches the dataset builder's section cap — a longer window costs VRAM you could spend on batch size.

provenance_rule: corpus = gate-passing, operator-approved repo assets only (see dataset/dataset-card.md). Do not add scraped data or outputs from models whose licence bars training on them.
recommendation_note: 117 SFT examples and 0 preference pairs is below the floor (150/40). A LoRA on this would mostly learn to imitate formatting while degrading instruction-following, and you would have no way to tell the difference at 40 examples.
